name: Commodity vs SPY & Gold: Pairwise Correlation Analysis
description: Analyzes pairwise daily return correlations across 7 commodity futures (Gold GC, Silver SI, Crude Oil CL, Natural Gas NG, Copper HG, Wheat ZW, Corn ZC) and SPY. Covers: (1) rolling 60-day correlation of each commodity vs SPY, (2) rolling 60-day correlation of each commodity vs Gold GC, (3) full-period NxN cross-sectional correlation heatmap of all assets, (4) summary table of mean/min/max rolling correlations per asset.
source:
# ==============================================================================
# Commodity vs SPY & Gold: Pairwise Correlation Analysis
# Daily returns | Rolling 60D Pearson | Full-period heatmap | Summary table
# Assets: GC, SI, CL, NG, HG, ZW, ZC (Futures) + SPY (Stocks)
# ==============================================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. PRIMARY ASSET DATA
#    futures_continuation handles all futures; passes through SPY unchanged
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()

cont = futures_continuation(
    timeframe=1D,
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

close = cont.c

# Daily percent returns (per primary asset)
ret = returns(period=1)(close)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. CROSS-SECTIONAL REFERENCE: SPY and GC for per-asset pairwise rolling corr
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

spy_ref = reference_stocks(ticker='SPY')()
ret_spy = returns(period=1)(spy_ref.c)

gc_ref = reference_stocks(ticker='GC')()
ret_gc = returns(period=1)(gc_ref.c)

# Bar index for xy_lines x-axis
idx = index()()

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. ROLLING 60D CORRELATION: Each Asset vs SPY
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

corr_vs_spy_60d = rolling_corr(
    window=60,
    window_type=WindowType.rolling,
    method=CorrelationMethod.pearson
)(x=ret_spy, y=ret)

corr_vs_spy_expanding = rolling_corr(
    window=60,
    window_type=WindowType.expanding,
    method=CorrelationMethod.pearson
)(x=ret_spy, y=ret)

xy_lines(
    title="Rolling 60-Day Correlation vs SPY",
    category="1. Corr vs SPY",
    y_axis_label="Pearson Correlation",
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="60D Rolling", color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Full-Period (Expanding)", color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title="Zero"),
        ReferenceLine(value=0.5, color=Color.Green, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title="+0.5"),
        ReferenceLine(value=-0.5, color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title="-0.5")
    ])
)(idx, corr_vs_spy_60d, corr_vs_spy_expanding)

cards(
    layout=CardLayout(
        title="Correlation vs SPY Summary",
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Mean 60D Corr vs SPY", card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title="Min", card_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title="Max", card_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title="Full-Period Corr", card_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    ),
    category="1. Corr vs SPY"
)(corr_vs_spy_60d, corr_vs_spy_60d, corr_vs_spy_60d, corr_vs_spy_expanding)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. ROLLING 60D CORRELATION: Each Asset vs Gold (GC)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

corr_vs_gc_60d = rolling_corr(
    window=60,
    window_type=WindowType.rolling,
    method=CorrelationMethod.pearson
)(x=ret_gc, y=ret)

corr_vs_gc_expanding = rolling_corr(
    window=60,
    window_type=WindowType.expanding,
    method=CorrelationMethod.pearson
)(x=ret_gc, y=ret)

xy_lines(
    title="Rolling 60-Day Correlation vs Gold (GC)",
    category="2. Corr vs Gold",
    y_axis_label="Pearson Correlation",
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="60D Rolling", color=Color.Gold),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Full-Period (Expanding)", color=Color.Amber, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title="Zero"),
        ReferenceLine(value=0.5, color=Color.Green, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title="+0.5"),
        ReferenceLine(value=-0.5, color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title="-0.5")
    ])
)(idx, corr_vs_gc_60d, corr_vs_gc_expanding)

cards(
    layout=CardLayout(
        title="Correlation vs Gold (GC) Summary",
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Mean 60D Corr vs GC", card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title="Min", card_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title="Max", card_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title="Full-Period Corr", card_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    ),
    category="2. Corr vs Gold"
)(corr_vs_gc_60d, corr_vs_gc_60d, corr_vs_gc_60d, corr_vs_gc_expanding)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. FULL-PERIOD NxN CROSS-SECTIONAL CORRELATION HEATMAP
#    All 8 assets (GC, SI, CL, NG, HG, ZW, ZC, SPY) x each other
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cs_heatmap(
    mode=HeatmapMode.correlation,
    title="Full-Period Pairwise Correlation Matrix — Daily Returns",
    category="3. Correlation Heatmap",
    show_data_labels=True,
    data_label_format="{point.value:.2f}",
    color_axis_min=-1,
    color_axis_max=1,
    max_assets=10
)(ret)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. CROSS-SECTIONAL SUMMARY TABLE
#    Rows = each asset | Columns = corr metrics vs SPY and vs Gold
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cs_summary_table(
    title="Pairwise Correlation Summary — All Assets",
    category="4. Summary Table",
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Mean Corr vs SPY (60D)", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title="Min Corr vs SPY (60D)", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title="Max Corr vs SPY (60D)", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title="Full-Period Corr vs SPY", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title="Mean Corr vs GC (60D)", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title="Min Corr vs GC (60D)", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title="Max Corr vs GC (60D)", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title="Full-Period Corr vs GC", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    ),
    max_assets=10
)(
    corr_vs_spy_60d,
    corr_vs_spy_60d,
    corr_vs_spy_60d,
    corr_vs_spy_expanding,
    corr_vs_gc_60d,
    corr_vs_gc_60d,
    corr_vs_gc_60d,
    corr_vs_gc_expanding
)
